frozen_protocol.hypothesis: Source-bound issuer research briefs improve numeric fact accuracy and attribution without fabricated material citations.
frozen_protocol.cost_assumptions: Record model, prompt, corpus, document, issuer, retrieval, and human-review costs; do not impute missing values.
frozen_protocol.acceptance: Accuracy >= 0.98; issuer attribution precision >= 0.99; zero fabricated material citations; compare both baselines on identical cases.

limitations: This protocol was recorded after initial prompt development and therefore cannot satisfy the historical pre-tuning freeze requirement.
No user-supplied or independently adjudicated facts, issuer set, research questions, or source-rights evidence are included.
Do not report target attainment or effectiveness until the required corpus and both baselines are measured.
